'''Lee Sung-yang''' ({{zh|c=李淳陽|p=Lǐ Chúnyáng}}, 29 May 1922 – 2014) was a Taiwanese entomologist. He was the subject of the 1975 [[BBC]] documentary ''The Insect World of Dr. Lee''. In [[Taiwan]], he is referred to as the "Taiwanese [[Jean Henri Fabre]]." Lee died in 2014.<ref>{{cite web |title=廖日京與嘉義的一天 |url=https://chiayiwiki.inarch.org/?p=1056 |website=ChiayiWiki |access-date=29 April 2026 |date=11 December 2024}}</ref>
